x: Wright, Bayliss, Cotton, Jordan, Harley, Chantler and Walker in particular for their regular weeky contributions to the Football Scheme, and all those others who are assisting in some way or other.

Cotton had come up strongly with Barrett and they had passed Tunbridge and Brazier. Leaving Wimbledon Common for the second time, the leading positions were unchanged, but McMullen and Gregory were having a private "ding-dong" of their own some 120 yards in arrear and had also pulled away from the next bunch.
They'd gone into second place through Cotton who ran fastest on the stage and they had two very good men to come - but they had 1 min 55 secs to make up.
